title.ko: 생활 습관 · 조언 · 현재완료진행 · should/ought to
title.en: lifestyle · advice · present perfect continuous · should and ought to

explain.ko: 건강에 관한 글에서는 생활 습관, 조언, 예방을 다룹니다. 최근까지 이어지는 행동은 현재완료진행형(I have been exercising for six months)으로 말합니다. 조언은 should, ought to, had better로 하며 ought to는 should와 비슷하지만 더 격식 있는 느낌입니다. 예방은 prevent + 명사, 회복은 recover from으로 말합니다. 균형 잡힌 식단(balanced diet), 충분한 수면(enough sleep), 규칙적인 운동(regular exercise)은 건강의 기본 요소입니다.
explain.en: Texts on health cover lifestyle, advice and prevention. Use the present perfect continuous for actions that continue up to now (I have been exercising for six months). Give advice with should, ought to, had better; ought to is similar to should but slightly more formal. Prevent + noun, recover from + noun. Balanced diet, enough sleep and regular exercise are the basics of health.

notes.ko: 현재완료진행형은 기간(for, since)과 함께 자주 씁니다.
notes.en: The present perfect continuous goes with for and since.

notes.ko: ought to는 부정문에서 ought not to로 씁니다.
notes.en: The negative is ought not to.
Health is a noun; healthy is an adjective.

prompt.en: Write 4 sentences about healthy habits and advice, using one present perfect continuous.

task.model: I have been exercising regularly for the last six months. A balanced diet and enough sleep are also important for health. When you are stressed you should relax by taking a walk. You ought to have a check-up once a year.

model_trans.ko: 저는 지난 6개월 동안 규칙적으로 운동하고 있어요. 균형 잡힌 식단과 충분한 수면도 건강에 중요합니다. 스트레스를 받을 때는 산책하며 긴장을 풀어야 합니다. 일 년에 한 번은 건강 검진을 받는 것이 좋습니다.
model_trans.en: I have been exercising regularly for the last six months. A balanced diet and enough sleep are also important for health. When you are stressed you should relax by taking a walk. You ought to have a check-up once a year.
